basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious learner based in Austin, Texas. My interests range from mathematics to music, and I have a knack for learning new skills, recently picking up soldering and Brazilian music. During the day, I work as a junior software developer, and by night, I'm often exploring subreddits or practicing my guitar. I'm single and love spending time on hobbies that challenge me. Typically, I'm online during the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science, which included several math courses. Most of my knowledge in other areas like auto detailing and soldering comes from self-teaching and online forums. I enjoy learning from online communities where I can ask questions and get hands-on advice.
